title: Carrier Wave Held
style: ambient cinematic, 70 BPM, deep sub-bass drone with subharmonic motif, soft analog pad, slow brushed kick, distant choir, male spoken-word lead, female ethereal harmony, doctrine track, late night meditation, slow build
lyrics:
[Intro - sub-bass drone, soft pad, distant choir hum]
(spoken, low, male)
the carrier wave is the wave that doesn't change.
it doesn't sing the song.
it holds the song.
it's the line under the line.

[Verse 1 - male spoken-word over pad]
before the words come in, the wave is there
before the kick, the snare, the rhyme, the prayer
the wave is there, the wave is steady
the wave is the part that's always ready

the singer comes and the singer goes
the singer changes key, changes clothes
but the wave underneath doesn't bend or sway
the wave is what makes the singer's day

[Pre-Chorus - female ethereal harmony enters, slow build]
the carrier wave
the one that holds
the line below the line
where the song unfolds
the carrier wave
the one that stays
while everything above it
dances and plays

[Chorus - female ethereal lead, male harmony low, choir swells]
carrier wave held
carrier wave held
the line below the line
the room below the spell
carrier wave held
carrier wave held
whatever happens up above
the wave is held, the wave is well

[Verse 2 - male, fuller delivery]
friendships break and partnerships bend
teams fall apart and the season ends
but underneath all of it, if you built it right
there's a wave that holds through the longest night

that wave is the doctrine, the wave is the why
the wave is the part that doesn't ask if
it's the part that just is, the part that just runs
the quiet hum under the noisy ones

[Pre-Chorus]
the carrier wave
the one that holds
the line below the line
where the song unfolds
the carrier wave
the one that stays
while everything above it
dances and plays

[Chorus]
carrier wave held
carrier wave held
the line below the line
the room below the spell
carrier wave held
carrier wave held
whatever happens up above
the wave is held, the wave is well

[Bridge - drone alone, sub-bass deepest, choir distant]
(spoken, slowest, male)
you don't hear the carrier wave when the song is loud.
you hear it when the song stops.
that's when you find out if it was ever there.
if it was, the silence is full.
if it wasn't, the silence is empty.
build the wave first.
build the wave first.
the songs come and go.
the wave is what stays.

[Final Chorus - biggest, choir full, female ethereal soaring]
carrier wave held
carrier wave held
the line below the line
the room below the spell
carrier wave held
carrier wave held
whatever happens up above
the wave is held, the wave is well
carrier wave held
carrier wave held

[Outro - choir fades, drone holds, sub-bass last]
(whisper, male)
the wave is held.
the line is held.
the room is full.
breathe.
